name: Copians
description: The Copians were an East Harlem gang active in the early 1950s that had disappeared by the late 1950s. They had ongoing trouble with another East Harlem gang called the Dragons. On November 8, 1953, four Copians members chased a Dragon near Lexington Avenue, caught him, beat him with their fists, and shot him three times in the back with a .22 caliber Smith and Wesson revolver. The victim died instantly. All four Copians were convicted of the murder and sent to various institutions.
